title: Thirteen to Sixteen
label: ch:mr-thirteen-to-sixteen
canDo: I can count to sixteen and take each teen apart into the unit at its front and the ten behind it.

payoff.summary: Complete MR-R57-thirteen-to-sixteen and take each teen apart, naming the unit at its front and the worn ten behind it.
payoff.note: Four teens in one chapter because the pattern is the same four times; the reader is learning one construction, not four words.
